s1.description: A chatbot is a next-word guesser, and everyone plays one in the story game.

s2.description: Every word has a home address, and attention knows which way to step.

s3.description: The AI looks things up to build a useful answer.

s4.description: Agents go beyond talking and get real jobs done.

s5.description: Picture-making AI turns noise into a cat on a fence.

s6.description: The machines get bodies, the home robot arrives, and Skynet comes online.
